title: Dell security advisory (AV26-1161)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1161 Date: November 16, 2026 As of November 16, 2026, Dell is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Ansible Storage for PowerFlex Prior to 3.2.0 Ansible Storage for PowerStore Prior to 3.9.0 Ansible Storage for Unity Prior to 1.2.13 OpenManage Ansible Modules Prior to 11.0.0 PowerScale InsightIQ Prior to 6.4.1 PowerStore 5000T Prior to 5.1.0.0-2798105 Terraform Provider for PowerFlex Prior to 1.9.0 Terraform Provider for PowerStore Prior to 1.3.1 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Dell PowerStore T Security Update for Multiple Vulnerabilities Security Update for Dell PowerScale InsightIQ Multiple Vulnerabilities Security Update for Dell Terraform Provider for Dell Storage Multiple Vulnerabilities Security Update for Dell Ansible Storage Multiple Vulnerabilities Security Update for Dell Ansible Server Vulnerabilities Security Advisories, Notices and Resources Article Link: Dell security advisory (AV26-1161) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
